history.summary: A 592 sqft freehold 1BR in D20 (Bishan/Marymount) at $1.22M ($2,061 PSF). Despite a strong-looking 6.8%/yr URA rate, the very weak arena record (95-220, elo 868) and a $1.22M one-bedder at $2,061 PSF flag this as an expensive, niche unit with a shallow exit pool.
history.rating_rationale: $2,061 PSF for a 1BR is high even for freehold D20, and $1.22M is a lot to pay for a single-bedroom in a non-prime location 930m (11-min walk) from Marymount MRT. The 6.8%/yr rate rests on only 17 transactions and equals the project median PSF — no discount on offer. The arena's brutal 95-220 record and 868 elo reflect poor relative value; this is a price-taker, not a deal. Niche 1BR buyer pool plus full-price entry = weak exit risk.
red_flags: $2,061 PSF for a 1BR is expensive for non-prime D20
Worst arena record in batch (95-220, elo 868)
Only 17 URA txns; rate not robust
11-min walk to MRT; 1BR has the shallowest buyer pool
catalysts: Bishan/Thomson area has good schools and amenities
